105:t_2:67.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's not what I mean...!」

105:t_2:68.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「What I expect from you is your tenacity in surviving, not that.」

105:t_2:70.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「People called me Immortal $$コーラサワー$$, but even I don't think immortality or invincibility really exists.」

105:t_2:71.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「But I haven't survived just on good luck. I'm alive because I was determined to live.」

105:t_2:74.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I sense something in you that's like me. So... keep at it.」

105:t_2:76.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...$$刹那$$ and $n are both changing through their relationships with others.」

105:t_2:77.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. And it doesn't only apply to individuals.」

105:t_2:78.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Do you mean humanity as a whole will change?」

105:t_2:80.en:
$$アムロ$$
(For that to happen, we can't let Earth... humanity come to an end...)

105:t_2:81.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$, please come up to the bridge immediately.」

105:t_2:83.en:
$$ミコット$$
「We have a transmission from Commander $$ブライト$$. $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces have apparently descended to North America.」

105:t_2:85.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So this day has finally come...」

105:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(...No sooner do we land on Earth than we go straight into battle. As always, everyone's knack for attracting trouble amazes me.)

105:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(And you wiped out the entire escort force too... Even I, $$ＡＧ$$, was surprised.)

105:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Everyone's high morale generated 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$. I'll add them to the unit's stock.)

105:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But I doubt this is all the strength the $$新地球皇国$$ has. Do be careful...)

105:t_10:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Did you get the drinks I asked for?」

105:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Y-yes... Well... It was a request from none other than you, $$スメラギ$$.」

105:t_10:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I feel like having a drink today. Could you bring it out?」

105:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is it to take your mind off $$サイデリアル$$'s threat and your fear of $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s invasion?」

105:t_10:15.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Everyone in $c will think about that together. My drinking is for more personal reasons.」

105:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I understand. You're at that age too, $$スメラギ$$.」

105:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your old classmate has married happily... Her husband can be carefree, but he's a good-natured ace pilot who's head over heels for her.」

105:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course you can't bear it without a drink. These drinks... will be on the house.」

105:t_10:21.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Actually, I just wanted to raise a glass while gazing at the moon, since it's been so long since I was on Earth...)

105:t_10:22.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Since he's offering, maybe I'll take advantage of $$ＡＧ$$'s misunderstanding this time...)

105:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Listen, $$スメラギ$$. No matter how sad you are, every night has a dawn. Stay strong and live with a smile.」

105:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go! Let's get to work again today...」

105:t_10:27.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$... You may have been a little off the mark, but the thought is more than enough.)

105:t_10:28.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Even someone like me has people who care... That alone warms my heart.)

106:t_000:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Damn $$サイデリアル$$! I won't let you do whatever you want any longer!」

106:t_001:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Damn it! We came to rescue them, but now we're in worse trouble!」

106:t_001:1.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Lieutenant $$パトリック#colasour$$! If this keeps up...!」

106:t_001:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Don't worry! The Colonel... I mean, the Brigadier General has requested reinforcements!」

106:t_001:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「It looks like they made it in time! Look!」

106:t_002:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I've been waiting for you, $c!」

106:t_002:1.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「They're the unit they called the Federation's strongest...!」

106:t_002:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's right. By the way, I used to be a member myself.」

106:t_002:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「So there you have it! Leave the rest to us and fall back!」

106:t_002:5.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「The battle with the Empire is still going back and forth. Don't pick the wrong place to risk your lives.」

106:t_002:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Besides, you know my old nickname, right?」

106:t_002:7.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「You were Immortal $$コーラサワー$$...」

106:t_002:8.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Do you feel better now? ...Stand by in the area until I give you orders.」

106:t_002:9.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「I understand! We wish you success!」

106:t_003:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「All right... Let's do this, $c!」

106:t_004:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「It's been a while, $n! But if you're going to be my partner, call me the right name!」

106:t_004:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's the spirit! And our real target took the bait and came out!」

106:t_005:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I'm detecting numerous transport ships!」

106:t_005:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「It seems the $$新地球皇国$$ intends to abduct civilians from that town on the $$レイライン$$.」

106:t_005:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Tch...! Those bastards are kidnapping people here too!」

106:t_005:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, spread out! We'll break through the escort force and stop the transports!」

106:t_005:5.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Please wait! Something else is coming out!」

106:t_006:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「So you are alive after all, $c.」

106:t_006:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's $$ダバラーン・タウ$$, the one we met in Japan...!」

106:t_006:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「How unfortunate for you. The $$時空震動$$ spared your lives, only for you to lose them here.」

106:t_006:3.en:
$n
「Don't decide where our lives are headed.」

106:t_006:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What are you planning to do with the people you abduct!?」

106:t_006:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...All ships, head north. The escort force will engage $c.」

106:t_006:6.en:
$$カツ$$
「So you have no intention of answering!?」

106:t_006:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「You want an answer? My $$バン・アルデバル$$ will give you one.」

106:t_006:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Don't think this ship is the same as an $$アドラティオ$$. I'll teach you your place.」

106:t_006:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Be careful. His pressure really is different from when we fought him in Japan.」
